newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu at northern base for rest-state TV.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu at northern base for rest-state TV.

text.p: Zairean state television said on Friday President Mobutu Sese Seko had flown to his northern stronghold of Gbadolite for rest on doctors' advice.

"The president of the republic went to Gbadolite this morning. He will take a few days of rest on the advice of his doctors," said the television. The report came amid speculation Mobutu was preparing to fly into exile as rebels close in on his capital.
